verdict.score_rationale: The board is comfortably readable with spacious, instantly recognizable regions and mostly clean flows, but several long cross-region feedback routes and relatively small text slow arm's-length tracing enough to fit the 7 anchor.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and label chips generally have generous clearance, though the small type inside many boxes and chips is difficult to read at arm's length.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Four large tinted, titled regions clearly separate ingestion, publication, retrieval, and model-rebuild responsibilities.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Local arrows and colored failure branches are clean, but the long blue and dashed teal routes spanning region boundaries require substantial eye travel and backtracking.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Main flows, decisions, retries, and fallback paths are visibly decomposed, although the oversized canvas and long feedback loops weaken the overall topology at a glance.
